blurb: UFO Parasail offers parasailing experiences where guests can fly alone, tandem, or three at a time, enjoying panoramic views of the Pacific and Hawaiian islands. Parasailing is easy, fun, and suitable for guests aged 5 and up. They also offer sport fishing, whale watching tours, and banana boat rides.
